%
% Topology transcribed device-by-device from the netlist of

% (subckt anatop_controlamp). Spectre order is M(drain gate source bulk).
% If the cell is re-netlisted, re-read that subckt before trusting this drawing.

\begin{figure}[htbp]
  \centering
  \resizebox{\linewidth}{!}{%
\begin{circuitikz}[scale=1.0, transform shape]
\ctikzset{bipoles/length=0.9cm, transistors/scale=0.80}
\tikzset{
  wire/.style={line width=0.6pt},
  nd/.style={circle, fill=black, inner sep=1.1pt},
  nlab/.style={font=\footnotesize, fill=white, inner sep=1pt},
  glab/.style={font=\scriptsize, inner sep=1pt},
  dlab/.style={font=\scriptsize, align=center, inner sep=1pt},
}
% ---- geometry -------------------------------------------------------------
\def\xL{0}      % left  branch: mirror-diode side
\def\xI{4.0}    % input pair, left device
\def\xJ{6.4}    % input pair, right device
\def\xT{5.2}    % tail
\def\xR{10.4}   % right branch: output side
\def\yvdd{10.6} \def\yvss{0.2}
\def\yPm{9.0}   % PMOS mirror + tail row
\def\ynA{7.5}   % net7 / net2 / net21
\def\yPc{6.3}   % PMOS cascodes + input pair row
\def\ymid{4.9}  % net6 / vout
\def\yNc{3.6}   % NMOS cascodes
\def\yfold{2.4} % net13 / net20
\def\yNm{1.2}   % NMOS current sources

% ---- rails ----------------------------------------------------------------
\draw[wire] (-2.6,\yvdd) -- (11.9,\yvdd) node[right, font=\footnotesize] {\texttt{vdd!}};
\draw[wire] (-2.6,\yvss) -- (11.9,\yvss) node[right, font=\footnotesize] {\texttt{vss!}};

% ---- left branch: M6 / M4 (diode side) ------------------------------------
\draw (\xL,\yPm) node[pmos, yscale=1](M6){};
\draw[wire] (M6.source) -- (\xL,\yvdd);
\draw[wire] (M6.drain) -- (\xL,\ynA);
\node[dlab, anchor=west] at (\xL+0.5,\yPm) {M6\\\scriptsize $m$=20};
\draw (\xL,\yPc) node[pmos, yscale=1](M4){};
\draw[wire] (M4.source) -- (\xL,\ynA);
\draw[wire] (M4.drain) -- (\xL,\ymid);
\node[dlab, anchor=west] at (\xL+0.5,\yPc) {M4\\\scriptsize $m$=10};
\node[nd] at (\xL,\ynA) {}; \node[nlab, anchor=east] at (\xL-0.15,\ynA) {\texttt{net7}};
\node[nd] at (\xL,\ymid) {}; \node[nlab, anchor=south east] at (\xL-0.1,\ymid+0.1) {\texttt{net6}};

% ---- left branch: M0 / M2 -------------------------------------------------
\draw (\xL,\yNc) node[nmos, yscale=1](M0){};
\draw[wire] (M0.drain) -- (\xL,\ymid);
\draw[wire] (M0.source) -- (\xL,\yfold);
\node[dlab, anchor=west] at (\xL+0.5,\yNc) {M0\\\scriptsize $m$=2};
\draw (\xL,\yNm) node[nmos, yscale=1](M2){};
\draw[wire] (M2.drain) -- (\xL,\yfold);
\draw[wire] (M2.source) -- (\xL,\yvss);
\node[dlab, anchor=west] at (\xL+0.5,\yNm) {M2\\\scriptsize $m$=5};
\node[nd] at (\xL,\yfold) {}; \node[nlab, anchor=south east] at (\xL-0.08,\yfold+0.08) {\texttt{net13}};

% ---- right branch: M7 / M5 / M1 / M3 --------------------------------------
\draw (\xR,\yPm) node[pmos, yscale=1](M7){};
\draw[wire] (M7.source) -- (\xR,\yvdd);
\draw[wire] (M7.drain) -- (\xR,\ynA);
\node[dlab, anchor=west] at (\xR+0.5,\yPm) {M7\\\scriptsize $m$=20};
\draw (\xR,\yPc) node[pmos, yscale=1](M5){};
\draw[wire] (M5.source) -- (\xR,\ynA);
\draw[wire] (M5.drain) -- (\xR,\ymid);
\node[dlab, anchor=west] at (\xR+0.5,\yPc) {M5\\\scriptsize $m$=10};
\node[nd] at (\xR,\ynA) {}; \node[nlab, anchor=east] at (\xR-0.15,\ynA) {\texttt{net21}};
\draw (\xR,\yNc) node[nmos, yscale=1](M1){};
\draw[wire] (M1.drain) -- (\xR,\ymid);
\draw[wire] (M1.source) -- (\xR,\yfold);
\node[dlab, anchor=west] at (\xR+0.5,\yNc) {M1\\\scriptsize $m$=2};
\draw (\xR,\yNm) node[nmos, yscale=1](M3){};
\draw[wire] (M3.drain) -- (\xR,\yfold);
\draw[wire] (M3.source) -- (\xR,\yvss);
\node[dlab, anchor=west] at (\xR+0.5,\yNm) {M3\\\scriptsize $m$=5};
\node[nd] at (\xR,\yfold) {}; \node[nlab, anchor=south west] at (\xR+0.08,\yfold+0.08) {\texttt{net20}};

% ---- output ---------------------------------------------------------------
\node[nd] at (\xR,\ymid) {};
\draw[wire] (\xR,\ymid) -- (11.7,\ymid);
\node[nlab, anchor=south] at (11.2,\ymid+0.1) {\texttt{vout}};

% ---- tail + input pair ----------------------------------------------------
\draw (\xT,\yPm) node[pmos, yscale=1](M10){};
\draw[wire] (M10.source) -- (\xT,\yvdd);
\draw[wire] (M10.drain) -- (\xT,\ynA);
\node[dlab, anchor=west] at (\xT+0.5,\yPm) {M10\\\scriptsize $m$=12};
\draw (\xI,\yPc) node[pmos, yscale=1](M8){};
\draw (\xJ,\yPc) node[pmos, xscale=-1, yscale=1](M9){};
\draw[wire] (M8.source) -- (\xI,\ynA) -- (\xJ,\ynA) -- (M9.source);
\node[nd] at (\xT,\ynA) {}; \node[nlab, above] at (\xT,\ynA) {\texttt{net2}};
\node[dlab, anchor=south] at (\xI,\yPc+0.62) {M8, $m$=6};
\node[dlab, anchor=south] at (\xJ,\yPc+0.62) {M9, $m$=6};
% input drains fold outward to the two branch folding nodes
\draw[wire] (M8.drain) -- (\xI,\yfold) -- (\xL,\yfold);
\draw[wire] (M9.drain) -- (\xJ,\yfold) -- (\xR,\yfold);
% input terminals
\draw[wire] (M8.gate) -- ++(-0.55,0) node[glab, left] {\texttt{vinp}};
\draw[wire] (M9.gate) -- ++(0.55,0) node[glab, right] {\texttt{vinm}};

% ---- gate biases ----------------------------------------------------------
\draw[wire] (M10.gate) -- ++(-0.55,0) node[glab, left] {\texttt{vbp}};
\draw[wire] (M4.gate) -- ++(-0.55,0) node[glab, left] {\texttt{vbpc}};
\draw[wire] (M5.gate) -- ++(-0.55,0) node[glab, left] {\texttt{vbpc}};
\draw[wire] (M0.gate) -- ++(-0.55,0) node[glab, left] {\texttt{vbnc}};
\draw[wire] (M1.gate) -- ++(-0.55,0) node[glab, left] {\texttt{vbnc}};
\draw[wire] (M2.gate) -- ++(-0.55,0) node[glab, left] {\texttt{vbn}};
\draw[wire] (M3.gate) -- ++(-0.55,0) node[glab, left] {\texttt{vbn}};

% ---- mirror gate: real wire in its own branch, name across ----------------
\draw[wire] (M6.gate) -- (-1.55,\yPm) -- (-1.55,\ymid) -- (\xL,\ymid);
\node[nd] at (-1.55,\ymid) {};
\draw[wire] (M7.gate) -- ++(-0.55,0) node[glab, left] {\texttt{net6}};
\end{circuitikz}
  }
  \caption{Control amplifier \texttt{anatop\_controlamp}: a single-stage folded
  cascode with a PMOS input pair. M10 is the tail; the pair M8/M9 steers its
  current into the folding nodes \texttt{net13} and \texttt{net20}, where the NMOS
  sources M2/M3 sink a fixed bias current. The difference passes up through the
  NMOS cascodes M0/M1 into the cascoded PMOS mirror M6/M4 (diode side, gate node
  \texttt{net6}) and M7/M5 (output side). Output and load current are summed at
  \texttt{vout}, the single high-impedance node, so there is no internal
  compensation capacitor --- the load capacitance sets the dominant pole. The
  mirror gate is drawn as a wire inside its own branch and identified by name on
  M7, rather than as a drawn bus. Every device is \(L=\SI{700}{\nano\metre}\),
  \(W=\SI{6}{\micro\metre}\); \(m\) is the multiplicity. Node names are the
  netlist's. \texttt{vbn}, \texttt{vbnc}, \texttt{vbp} and \texttt{vbpc} come from
  the local bias generator of Section~\ref{ss:biasgen-local}. \emph{Omitted:} the
  22 \texttt{ModgenDummy} matched-layout dummy devices (6 NMOS, 16 PMOS), whose
  terminals are tied to \texttt{vss!} or to a folding node and which carry no
  signal current.}
  \label{fig:ctrlamp-core}
\end{figure}
